name: PlasterWall
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.291

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: lime plaster built from Poly Haven painted_plaster_wall and plastered_wall_04 (both at non-commensurate scales) with trowel sweeps (overlapping arcs with a burnished lip, in height, normal and roughness), limewash coat variation in brushed strokes, and a hairline crack network with branches; graded to the grey-olive limewash of the original interior wall sprites
known_weaknesses: trowel sweeps and hairline cracks are synthesised and faint beyond 2 m; fairly even tone; one tile is one 2.5 m wall module, so offset UVs between modules (the wall kit does)
wall_grime_mask: non-tiling in V (0 floor, 1 ceiling), tiles in U; R damp at the base (darken x0.7, tint green-brown, roughness -0.15, or blend to the Damp/Broken variant), G soot under the ceiling (multiply toward 0.25 grey), B drip streaks
